name: Identity and Access Integration

identityContext.rule: WebEngine supplies normalized IAM identity context but does not authenticate credentials or own session state

accessCorePreflight.transport: dependency-injected; no HTTP endpoint invented by WebEngine

webEngineRole: load and normalize available IAM identity context
preserve anonymous identity separately from authorization denial
project IAM identity into an AccessCore subject without IAM management-tier authority leakage
request an AccessCore decision using explicit domain-owned action/resource semantics
publish denied without renderer mount on deny
mustNot: implement IAM authentication or session authority
persist passwords or raw IAM session/bearer tokens
translate IAM management tier into application permissions
derive action or resource semantics from projector identity
treat projector preflight as the service-side enforcement boundary
